===== FILE 2594__1.pdf =====
Veterans do not serve their country unconditionally. There is no point to enlisting 
in the military, accepting the potential risks of injury and disability, if the full 
spectrum of healthcare cannot be guaranteed. This will set the precedent for 
more healthcare restrictions down the line, driving recruitment numbers down 
even more drastically. There is no point in risking the bodily harm and emotional 
trauma intrinsic to armed conflict if something as basic as reproductive 
healthcare cannot be secured for all veterans. This is a dangerous, arrogant 
move on behalf of the Trump administration.
